problem_context.core_problem: Banks and financial institutions cannot demonstrate AI model compliance to regulators. Current compliance monitoring is manual, expensive, and fragmented across multiple systems.
affected_personas: Chief Compliance Officer at large banks
Chief Risk Officer at large banks
current_solutions: Generic model monitoring tools (incomplete compliance picture)

market_context.market_dynamics: Regulatory enforcement on AI increasing. Banks actively investing in compliance infrastructure.
market_context.regulatory_environment: Federal Reserve, SEC, OCC published AI guidance 2023-2024. Enforcement accelerating.

customer_context.jtbd_functional: Monitor and document AI model behavior for regulatory compliance
customer_context.jtbd_emotional: Confident that organization meets regulatory requirements

competitive_context.competitive_intensity: Medium (monitoring category established, but no integrated compliance platforms)

portfolio_context.strategic_fit_summary: Aligns with financial services and AI governance portfolio priorities
portfolio_context.capital_efficiency: Software business model; recurring revenue; high gross margins expected
portfolio_context.team_skill_fit: Portfolio has fintech expertise and compliance domain knowledge

key_assumptions: Regulatory enforcement will remain high for 3+ years
Banks will prefer integrated compliance platforms over point solutions
Willingness-to-pay driven by regulatory risk (not cost savings)
Technical approach to explainability will satisfy regulatory bar
Founder has regulatory and compliance domain expertise
data_gaps: Exact regulatory requirements interpretation (varies by bank/regulator)
Competitor product roadmaps (Regulatory AI and ModelWatch not transparent)
